text: The internet of things, a phrase Kevin Ashton coined in nineteen ninety nine, connects physical objects fitted with sensors and software so they exchange data and can be controlled remotely. It has four layers. Perception: the sensors. Network: the gateway and the link. Processing: the cloud that decides. Application: the app the farmer sees. Its weakest point is security: cheap devices shipped with default passwords have been hijacked into botnets.
